summary: Hafnia Limited, a Singapore-domiciled tanker owner, filed a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) disclosing an agreement to acquire 1,700,000 A shares of UK-listed TORM plc at USD 34.00 per share, equal to 1.66% of TORM's issued share capital. Post-closing Hafnia holds approximately 19.85% of TORM. Consideration is cash from balance-sheet cash and available credit facilities; no board recommendation, advisor, premium, or close date was disclosed. Watch for creeping-control dynamics, further open-market accumulation, and any move toward a full bid.
